status: Prepared before inspecting the new network implementation or its outcomes
scope: New small network, explicit weights from scratch, same 1080 LiDAR inputs and upstream simulator; no training, fitting or optimizer

development.selection: Mechanistic inspection and a small number of explicitly justified revisions; no automated threshold/weight sweeps. Do not count development outcomes as independent final evidence.

final.maps: All 21 repository maps with racelines, sorted
final.before_run: Freeze architecture source, weights/export, reference hash, evaluation code hash, seed/map list and primary candidate. No edits after seeing final outcomes.
final.evaluator: Reuse existing evaluate() unchanged: one lap, >=99% ordered waypoint progress AND start crossing, no collision, max 200s. Pair map/seed/reset and include all failures.
report: Completion, collisions, timeouts, gained/lost episodes against reference
Paired lap time changes only on jointly completed episodes, with denominator and per-map breakdown
Early failures retained; no filtering of problematic starts
If recording --state-trace, audit all recorded body footprints and report completed episodes with raster contact separately
No claim of new-track generalization: the maps are known; only seeds and starts/noise are new
No claim of controlled drift or guaranteed zero crashes from completion counts

artifact_audit.source: Inspect constructor and forward plus exported graph: all coefficients explicit; no PPO tensors loaded/copied, no random initialization left active, no fit/gradient/training step, no hidden controller outside module except original normalization/clipping
sizes: Dense parameter elements, dense buffer elements, nonzero elements of each, dtype and serialized bytes
Unique stored tensors/storage elements, aliases and tied/shared coefficients
Independent explicitly programmed coefficients versus logical expanded connections; disclose fixed architecture constants/literals
Compare against PPO actor-only 73474 scalars and full actor+critic/log_std checkpoint 146885 separately
artifact_audit.equivalence: Compare eager module, export and adapter on existing observations and synthetic scans; same normalization, action order and clipping
artifact_audit.latency: Same CPU, one torch thread, batch1, inference/no_grad, warmup128 then1000 calls in5 blocks on fixed preloaded observations. Report complete predict adapter p50/p95 and raw network path separately; exclude loading, simulator and disk IO. Do not compare new actor only against PPO actor+critic training forward.

synthetic_mirror_audit.input: 1080 angles spanning original LiDAR field of view; analytic parallel corridor walls and optional front wall, clipped to30m, original normalization. Mirrored scan is exact reversed input vector.
cases: Symmetric corridor left/right1m with front wall30m
Symmetric corridor left/right1m with front wall5m
Offset corridor left0.35m/right1.65m with front wall30m
Offset corridor left0.7m/right1.3m with front wall5m
Symmetric corridor with off-center bounded obstacle patch and its reflection
synthetic_mirror_audit.expected_relation: For intended mirror-symmetric design: steering(reverse(obs))=-steering(obs), speed(reverse(obs))=speed(obs), including exported module and adapter. Symmetric inputs imply zero steering. Report max absolute residual and dtype tolerance rather than fitting coefficients to cases.
synthetic_mirror_audit.limit: A symmetry check validates a structural property, not obstacle avoidance or racing performance.

known_physics_limits: Original wall TTC uses longitudinal extent lf+lr=0.3302m, shorter than declared body length0.58m
Original TTC projects velocity without slip beta
Raster footprint audit has map-resolution uncertainty and sees pre-action saved poses, not continuous trajectories or final post-step state
